sentence: This project builds a computer method that simulates flows of gas, liquid and solid that melt, solidify, evaporate and condense at the same time.
This project studies how parts of the brain control the drumming movements woodpeckers use to communicate, and how the brain hears those displays.
This project holds a two-day workshop where researchers share ideas and plan future research directions in areas such as robotics and bioengineering.
This project supports a conference where researchers study touch, tactile and force feedback, human perception, and wearable and robotic interfaces.
This project builds computer methods that find good trade-offs between competing goals and studies how quickly those methods reach answers.
This project looks for hidden protein-coding regions called open reading frames in four plants and studies what they do.
This project builds a web platform that hosts computer tools to identify pollen from images automatically.
This project studies model theory, a part of mathematical logic, and how it can be extended to continuous structures.
This project designs defenses that protect computer networks from an attacker who pretends to be many participants, while keeping costs low for legitimate participants.
This project builds a hands-on program that teaches microelectronics and semiconductors and studies what shapes choices of careers in science and technology.
This project studies whether a wearable sensing system that uses AI on the device can detect hazards and monitor health in dangerous places.
This project links researchers who study animal, human and machine intelligence and drafts a roadmap for working together.
This project measures the oxygen isotopes of seawater in the South Pacific and Southern Ocean and compares two ways of measuring them.
This project uses computer-assisted proofs and machine learning to study the Euler equation and related equations, including solutions that blow up.
This project teaches quantitative research methods such as structural equation modeling and Bayesian methods to researchers who study STEM education.
This project studies what controls how well single-atom metal catalysts make hydrogen from methanol and ammonia, using both experiments and computer simulation.
This project builds a data system on soil microbes and improves a computer model of the Earth to show how microbes affect carbon dioxide and methane.
